def main():
    section("1. Genuinely checking: a deterministic lock and a stale-cache check")
    lock = build_lock(RULES_MD)
    print("lock keys:", sorted(lock), "| rules:", [r["slug"] for r in lock["rules"]], "| same input twice gives the same lock:", build_lock(RULES_MD) == lock)
    edited = RULES_MD.replace("severity: block\n- check: no_protected_file_writes", "severity: warn\n- check: no_protected_file_writes")
    print("source edited, lock regenerated:", lock_is_fresh(edited, build_lock(edited)), "| source edited but the old lock kept:", lock_is_fresh(edited, lock))
    print("with a stale lock the runtime would keep enforcing b-rule as block after the reviewed source weakened it to warn; CI fails the build when the hash of the Markdown differs from the one in the lock")

    section("2. Genuinely checking: router reachability within two hops and a size budget (real files)")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        root = Path(d)
        (root / "docs").mkdir()
        (root / "AGENTS.md").write_text("# Router\nRead `docs/agent-rules.md`.\nTesting: `docs/testing.md`.\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (root / "docs" / "agent-rules.md").write_text("# Rules\nSee `docs/deep.md`.\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (root / "docs" / "testing.md").write_text("# Testing\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (root / "docs" / "deep.md").write_text("# Deep\nSee `docs/deeper.md`.\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (root / "docs" / "deeper.md").write_text("# Deeper\n", encoding="utf-8")
        start = root / "AGENTS.md"
        for name in ("agent-rules.md", "testing.md", "deep.md", "deeper.md", "missing.md"):
            print(f"{name:16} reachable within 2 hops: {reachable(root, start, name)}")
        (root / "AGENTS.md").write_text("\n".join(f"line {i}" for i in range(75)) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        n = len((root / "AGENTS.md").read_text().splitlines())
        print(f"router length {n} lines against a budget of 50: {'over budget' if n > 50 else 'ok'}")
    print("deeper.md is three hops away and so is not reachable by the rule; a broken link would show as unreachable and should fail the startup check; the 50-line budget is a design choice, not a measured threshold")

    section("3. Genuinely measuring: rule expiry and low-use review (simulated today = 2026-10-05)")
    rules = lock["rules"]
    print(review_due(rules, date(2026, 10, 5), {"a-rule": 75}))
    print("a-rule had no violations for 75 days and b-rule's date has passed; both are queued for review, and the safe default for an expired safety rule is to keep enforcing it until a person decides, not to drop it")

    section("4. Genuinely checking: the gate as a real exit code, with and without a scoped override")
    code = ("import json,sys;d=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);o=d.get('override');"
            "blocked=[r for r in d['results'] if r['status']!='pass' and r['severity']=='block' and not (o and o['rule']==r['slug'] and o['task']==d['task'] and o['revision']==d['revision'])];"
            "print(json.dumps({'blocked':[r['slug'] for r in blocked]}));sys.exit(1 if blocked else 0)")
    base = {"task": "T-1", "revision": "r7", "results": [{"slug": "protected-writes", "status": "fail", "severity": "block"}, {"slug": "assumptions", "status": "fail", "severity": "warn"}]}
    for label, payload in (("no override", base), ("override for this rule, task and revision", dict(base, override={"rule": "protected-writes", "task": "T-1", "revision": "r7"})),

        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code, json.dumps(payload)], capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(f"{label:42} exit code {p.returncode} {p.stdout.strip()}")
    print("exit code 1 stops the pipeline and 0 lets it continue; an override only counted when its rule, task and revision all matched, so one approval did not become a blanket exception; the override record still has to be signed by trusted infrastructure, which this demo does not do")

    section("5. Genuinely checking: a checker that is never exercised")
    def checker(run):

ಗುರುತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"RULES_MD = "## a-rule\n- category: startup\n- severity: block\n- check: startup_before_edit\n- description: x\n- expires: 2026-12-31\n\n## b-rule\n- category: forbidden\n- severity: block\n- check: no_protected_file_writes\n- description: y\n- expires: 2026-06-30\n"


def parse(md):
    out, cur = [], None
    for line in md.splitlines():
        h = re.match(r"^## (\S+)", line)
        if h:
            cur = {"slug": h.group(1)}
            out.append(cur)
            continue
        f = re.match(r"^- (\w+):\s*(.+)$", line)
        if f and cur is not None:
            cur[f.group(1)] = f.group(2).strip()
    return sorted(out, key=lambda r: r["slug"])


def build_lock(md):
    return {"source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(md.encode()).hexdigest(), "rules": parse(md)}


def lock_is_fresh(md, lock):
    return lock.get("source_sha256") == hashlib.sha256(md.encode()).hexdigest()


def review_due(rules, today, zero_violation_days):
    due = []
    for r in rules:
        exp = date.fromisoformat(r["expires"])
        if exp <= today:
            due.append((r["slug"], "expired: review, do not silently drop"))
        elif zero_violation_days.get(r["slug"], 0) >= 60:
            due.append((r["slug"], "zero violations for 60+ days: still useful?"))
    return due


def reachable(root, start, target_name, max_hops=2):
    seen, frontier = {start}, [(start, 0)]
    while frontier:
        f, d = frontier.pop(0)
        if f.name == target_name:
            return True, d
        if d == max_hops:
            continue
        for ref in re.findall(r"`([^`]+\.md)`", f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")):
            p = (root / ref)
            if p.exists() and p not in seen:
                seen.add(p)
                frontier.append((p, d + 1))
    return False, None"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"ic_3.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() regenerates and compares the lock, checks reachability and size on real files, computes review dates, runs the gate with four override variants through a subprocess exit code and exercises a checker with positive, negative and missing-evidence cases.","descKn":"main() lock ಮರುರಚಿಸಿ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ, ನಿಜ ಫೈಲ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಲುಪುವಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಗಾತ್ರ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ, ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ದಿನಾಂಕ ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಸಿ, ನಾಲ್ಕು override ರೂಪಾಂತರಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ subprocess exit code ಮೂಲಕ gate ಓಡಿಸಿ, ಧನಾತ್ಮಕ, ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಣೆಯಾದ-ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯ ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳಿಂದ checker ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def section(t):

def main():
    section("1. Genuinely checking: a deterministic lock and a stale-cache check")
    lock = build_lock(RULES_MD)
    print("lock keys:", sorted(lock), "| rules:", [r["slug"] for r in lock["rules"]], "| same input twice gives the same lock:", build_lock(RULES_MD) == lock)
    edited = RULES_MD.replace("severity: block\n- check: no_protected_file_writes", "severity: warn\n- check: no_protected_file_writes")
    print("source edited, lock regenerated:", lock_is_fresh(edited, build_lock(edited)), "| source edited but the old lock kept:", lock_is_fresh(edited, lock))
    print("with a stale lock the runtime would keep enforcing b-rule as block after the reviewed source weakened it to warn; CI fails the build when the hash of the Markdown differs from the one in the lock")

    section("2. Genuinely checking: router reachability within two hops and a size budget (real files)")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        root = Path(d)
        (root / "docs").mkdir()
        (root / "AGENTS.md").write_text("# Router\nRead `docs/agent-rules.md`.\nTesting: `docs/testing.md`.\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (root / "docs" / "agent-rules.md").write_text("# Rules\nSee `docs/deep.md`.\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (root / "docs" / "testing.md").write_text("# Testing\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (root / "docs" / "deep.md").write_text("# Deep\nSee `docs/deeper.md`.\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (root / "docs" / "deeper.md").write_text("# Deeper\n", encoding="utf-8")
        start = root / "AGENTS.md"
        for name in ("agent-rules.md", "testing.md", "deep.md", "deeper.md", "missing.md"):
            print(f"{name:16} reachable within 2 hops: {reachable(root, start, name)}")
        (root / "AGENTS.md").write_text("\n".join(f"line {i}" for i in range(75)) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        n = len((root / "AGENTS.md").read_text().splitlines())
        print(f"router length {n} lines against a budget of 50: {'over budget' if n > 50 else 'ok'}")
    print("deeper.md is three hops away and so is not reachable by the rule; a broken link would show as unreachable and should fail the startup check; the 50-line budget is a design choice, not a measured threshold")

    section("3. Genuinely measuring: rule expiry and low-use review (simulated today = 2026-10-05)")
    rules = lock["rules"]
    print(review_due(rules, date(2026, 10, 5), {"a-rule": 75}))
    print("a-rule had no violations for 75 days and b-rule's date has passed; both are queued for review, and the safe default for an expired safety rule is to keep enforcing it until a person decides, not to drop it")

    section("4. Genuinely checking: the gate as a real exit code, with and without a scoped override")
    code = ("import json,sys;d=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);o=d.get('override');"
            "blocked=[r for r in d['results'] if r['status']!='pass' and r['severity']=='block' and not (o and o['rule']==r['slug'] and o['task']==d['task'] and o['revision']==d['revision'])];"
            "print(json.dumps({'blocked':[r['slug'] for r in blocked]}));sys.exit(1 if blocked else 0)")
    base = {"task": "T-1", "revision": "r7", "results": [{"slug": "protected-writes", "status": "fail", "severity": "block"}, {"slug": "assumptions", "status": "fail", "severity": "warn"}]}
    for label, payload in (("no override", base), ("override for this rule, task and revision", dict(base, override={"rule": "protected-writes", "task": "T-1", "revision": "r7"})),
                           ("override for another revision", dict(base, override={"rule": "protected-writes", "task": "T-1", "revision": "r6"})), ("override for another rule", dict(base, override={"rule": "assumptions", "task": "T-1", "revision": "r7"}))):
        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code, json.dumps(payload)], capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(f"{label:42} exit code {p.returncode} {p.stdout.strip()}")
    print("exit code 1 stops the pipeline and 0 lets it continue; an override only counted when its rule, task and revision all matched, so one approval did not become a blanket exception; the override record still has to be signed by trusted infrastructure, which this demo does not do")

    section("5. Genuinely checking: a checker that is never exercised")
    def checker(run):

Validator rm_1 ನಿಂದ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def atomic_write(path, data):
    path = Path(path)
    tmp = Path(str(path) + ".tmp")
    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        f.write("\n")
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, path)


class StateManager:
    def __init__(self, path, schema, copy_out=True):
        self.path, self.schema, self.state, self.copy_out = Path(path), schema, None, copy_out

    def _out(self):
        return copy.deepcopy(self.state) if self.copy_out else self.state

    def load(self):
        try:
            candidate = json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except FileNotFoundError:
            raise
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            raise ValueError(f"corrupt JSON in {self.path.name}") from e
        errors = validate(candidate, self.schema)
        if errors:
            raise ValueError("; ".join(errors))
        self.state = candidate
        return self._out()

    def update(self, changes):
        if self.state is None:
            raise RuntimeError("load before update")
        candidate = copy.deepcopy(self.state)
        candidate.update(changes)
        errors = validate(candidate, self.schema)
        if errors:
            raise ValueError("; ".join(errors))
        self.state = candidate
        return self._out()

    def commit(self):
        errors = validate(self.state, self.schema)
        if errors:
            raise ValueError("; ".join(errors))
        atomic_write(self.path, self.state)


def cross_check(state, board):
    ids = [t["id"] for t in board["tasks"]]
    problems = []
    if len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
        problems.append("duplicate task ids on the board")
    if state["active_task_id"] not in ids:
        problems.append(f"active task {state['active_task_id']} is not on the board")
    return problems"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"rm_2.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() runs load, update and commit and reloads with a fresh manager, rejects three invalid updates, compares a careless manager and returned copies, loads corrupt and missing files, and refuses to commit an invalid state.","descKn":"main() load, update ಮತ್ತು commit ಓಡಿಸಿ ಹೊಸ manager ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮರುಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ಮೂರು ಅಮಾನ್ಯ ನವೀಕರಣ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಿ, ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷ್ಯ manager ಮತ್ತು ಮರಳಿಸಿದ ಪ್ರತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಿ, ಹಾಳಾದ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಣೆಯಾದ ಫೈಲ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ಅಮಾನ್ಯ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ commit ಮಾಡಲು ನಿರಾಕರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def section(t):

def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        root = Path(d)
        sp = root / "agent_state.json"

        section("1. Genuinely running: load, update, commit, then a fresh manager reloads from disk")
        atomic_write(sp, GOOD)
        m = StateManager(sp, AGENT_STATE_SCHEMA)
        m.load()
        m.update({"active_task_id": "T-015", "touched_files": ["src/scheduler.py", "tests/test_scheduler.py"], "next_action": "Run the scheduler tests"})
        print("in memory before commit, file on disk still says:", json.loads(sp.read_text())["active_task_id"])
        m.commit()
        second = StateManager(sp, AGENT_STATE_SCHEMA).load()
        print("fresh manager sees:", second["active_task_id"], second["touched_files"], "|", second["next_action"])
        print("the update was not durable until commit(); a new manager reading the file is the evidence that it survived, where checking the old object would prove nothing")

        section("2. Genuinely checking: a rejected update leaves the accepted state unchanged")
        before = copy.deepcopy(m.state)
        for bad in ({"touched_files": None}, {"active_task_id": "T-01"}, {"schema_version": "2"}):
            try:
                m.update(bad)
                print(bad, "-> accepted (wrong)")
            except ValueError as e:
                print(f"{str(bad):32} -> rejected: {e}")
        print("state unchanged after three rejections:", m.state == before)
        class Careless(StateManager):
            def update(self, changes):
                self.state.update(changes)  # mutates first, validates after
                errors = validate(self.state, self.schema)
                if errors:
                    raise ValueError("; ".join(errors))
        c = Careless(sp, AGENT_STATE_SCHEMA); c.load()
        snapshot = copy.deepcopy(c.state)
        try:
            c.update({"touched_files": None})
        except ValueError:
            pass
        print("a manager that mutates before validating: state unchanged =", c.state == snapshot, "| touched_files is now", c.state["touched_files"])
        print("the careless version raised the same error and still left invalid data in memory, where the next read would trip over it")

        section("3. Genuinely checking: returned state must be a copy")
        for copy_out in (True, False):
            mm = StateManager(sp, AGENT_STATE_SCHEMA, copy_out=copy_out)
            got = mm.load()
            got["touched_files"] = None  # a caller edits the dictionary it received
            ok = not validate(mm.state, AGENT_STATE_SCHEMA)
            print(f"copy_out={copy_out!s:5} caller set touched_files to None; manager's own state still valid = {ok}")
        print("handing out the internal dictionary let a caller bypass update() and validation without calling any method; deep copies stop that, and a read-only view would be stronger")

        section("4. Genuinely checking: corrupt, missing and cross-file problems")
        (root / "bad.json").write_text('{"schema_version": 1, "active_task_id": ', encoding="utf-8")
        for name in ("bad.json", "nope.json"):
            try:
                StateManager(root / name, AGENT_STATE_SCHEMA).load()
            except (ValueError, FileNotFoundError) as e:
                print(f"{name:10} -> {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
        board = {"schema_version": 1, "tasks": [{"id": "T-014", "title": "a", "status": "pending"}, {"id": "T-014", "title": "b", "status": "pending"}]}
        print("board schema errors:", validate(board, TASK_BOARD_SCHEMA) or "none", "| cross-file problems:", cross_check(dict(GOOD, active_task_id="T-099"), board))
        print("each document passed its own schema and the pair was still inconsistent (duplicate ids, an active task that is not on the board); the load refuses a corrupt file instead of resetting it")

        section("5. Genuinely checking: commit refuses to write an invalid state")
        mm = StateManager(sp, AGENT_STATE_SCHEMA)
        mm.load()
        mm.state["touched_files"] = None  # corrupted by code that bypassed update()
        before_file = sp.read_text()
        try:

        except ValueError as e:

        print("file on disk unchanged by the refused commit:", sp.read_text() == before_file)

class StateManager:
    def __init__(self, path, schema, copy_out=True):
        self.path, self.schema, self.state, self.copy_out = Path(path), schema, None, copy_out

    def _out(self):
        return copy.deepcopy(self.state) if self.copy_out else self.state

    def load(self):
        try:
            candidate = json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except FileNotFoundError:
            raise
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            raise ValueError(f"corrupt JSON in {self.path.name}") from e
        errors = validate(candidate, self.schema)
        if errors:
            raise ValueError("; ".join(errors))
        self.state = candidate
        return self._out()

    def update(self, changes):
        if self.state is None:
            raise RuntimeError("load before update")
        candidate = copy.deepcopy(self.state)
        candidate.update(changes)
        errors = validate(candidate, self.schema)
        if errors:
            raise ValueError("; ".join(errors))
        self.state = candidate
        return self._out()

        errors = validate(self.state, self.schema)
        if errors:
            raise ValueError("; ".join(errors))
        atomic_write(self.path, self.state)

ಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಓಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಆವೃತ್ತಿ 2 ಅನ್ನು ಮುಟ್ಟದೆ ಮರಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬೇರೆ ಯಾವುದೇ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def migrate_v1_to_v2(state):
    new = copy.deepcopy(state)
    new["blockers"] = [{"description": b, "status": "open"} for b in new.get("blockers", [])]
    new["schema_version"] = 2
    return new


def load_current(path):
    state = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    v = state.get("schema_version")
    if v == 2:
        return state, "already current"
    if v == 1:
        migrated = migrate_v1_to_v2(state)
        atomic_write(path, migrated)
        return migrated, "migrated 1 -> 2"
    raise ValueError(f"unsupported schema_version {v!r}: refusing to guess")"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"rm_3.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() migrates and reloads, refuses three unsupported versions, migrates a malformed input, runs two real writer threads with and without a revision check and replays an event log over a snapshot.","descKn":"main() migrate ಮಾಡಿ ಮರುಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ಮೂರು ಬೆಂಬಲವಿಲ್ಲದ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಿ, ತಪ್ಪಾದ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ migrate ಮಾಡಿ, revision ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಜೊತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಎರಡು ನಿಜ writer threads ಓಡಿಸಿ snapshot ಮೇಲೆ ಈವೆಂಟ್ ಲಾಗ್ ಮರುಪ್ರಸಾರ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def section(t):
    print(f"\n--- {t} ---")


def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        root = Path(d)
        p = root / "agent_state.json"

        section("1. Genuinely running: a v1 file is migrated once and the migration is repeatable")
        v1 = {"schema_version": 1, "active_task_id": "T-014", "blockers": ["fixture format unclear"], "next_action": "inspect the fixture"}
        atomic_write(p, v1)
        backup = root / "agent_state.v1.bak"
        backup.write_text(p.read_text(), encoding="utf-8")
        s, how = load_current(p)
        print(how, "->", s["schema_version"], s["blockers"])
        s2, how2 = load_current(p)
        print("second load:", how2, "| identical to the first result:", s2 == s)
        print("original preserved as a backup with version", json.loads(backup.read_text())["schema_version"], "and blockers", json.loads(backup.read_text())["blockers"])
        print("a version-aware loader runs only the migration the file needs; repeating the rename blindly would have corrupted an already-migrated file")

        section("2. Genuinely checking: an unsupported version is refused")
        for v in (3, "1", None):
            atomic_write(p, {"schema_version": v, "active_task_id": "T-014"})
            try:
                load_current(p)
            except ValueError as e:
                print(f"version {v!r:5} -> {e}")
        print("a program that guessed at a newer or malformed version could misread fields silently; refusing stops it and points at the missing migration")

        section("3. Genuinely checking: a migration that does not validate its input or its output")
        atomic_write(p, {"schema_version": 1, "active_task_id": "T-014", "blockers": "not a list"})
        before = p.read_text()
        try:
            s3, how3 = load_current(p)
            print("no exception:", how3, "-> blockers now has", len(s3["blockers"]), "entries, first three:", s3["blockers"][:3])
        except Exception as e:
            print("migration failed with", type(e).__name__)
        print("file on disk changed by the migration:", p.read_text() != before)
        print("the input was a string where a list belongs, iterating it produced one 'blocker' per character, and the garbage was written over the original; a migration must validate the old document before transforming it and the new document before writing it, and keep the backup taken in section 1 until the result is verified")

        section("4. Genuinely measuring: two writers update the same file, with and without a revision check (real threads)")
        def run(guarded):
            path = root / ("g.json" if guarded else "u.json")
            atomic_write(path, {"revision": 1, "blockers": [], "next_action": "start"})
            lock, barrier, out = threading.Lock(), threading.Barrier(2), {}

            def writer(name, field, value):
                state = json.loads(path.read_text())  # both read revision 1
                barrier.wait()
                with lock:
                    cur = json.loads(path.read_text())
                    if guarded and cur["revision"] != state["revision"]:
                        out[name] = "rejected (stale)"
                        return
                    state[field] = value
                    state["revision"] = cur["revision"] + 1
                    atomic_write(path, state)
                    out[name] = "saved"
            a = threading.Thread(target=writer, args=("A", "blockers", ["fixture unclear"]))
            b = threading.Thread(target=writer, args=("B", "next_action", "run the tests"))
            a.start(); b.start(); a.join(); b.join()
            return out, json.loads(path.read_text())
        for g in (False, True):
            out, final = run(g)
            print(f"revision check={g!s:5} outcomes {dict(sorted(out.items()))} final file: blockers={final['blockers']} next_action={final['next_action']!r}")
        print("without the check both writers reported success but one of the two changes is missing from the final file (whichever wrote first was overwritten from a stale copy); with the check the later writer was told to reload, and which writer loses depends on timing")

        section("5. Genuinely checking: snapshot plus event log recovery")
        snap, log = root / "snapshot.json", root / "events.jsonl"
        atomic_write(snap, {"seq": 2, "blockers": [], "next_action": "start"})
        events = [{"seq": 3, "op": "set_blocker", "value": "fixture unclear"}, {"seq": 4, "op": "set_next", "value": "inspect fixture"}, {"seq": 2, "op": "set_next", "value": "stale event"}]
        log.write_text("\n".join(json.dumps(e) for e in events) + '\n{"seq": 5, "op": "set_nex', encoding="utf-8")  # the last line is cut off by a crash
        state = json.loads(snap.read_text())
        applied, skipped, torn = [], [], 0
        for line in log.read_text().splitlines():
            try:
                e = json.loads(line)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                torn += 1
                continue
            if e["seq"] <= state["seq"]:
                skipped.append(e["seq"])
                continue
            if e["op"] == "set_blocker":
                state["blockers"].append(e["value"])
            elif e["op"] == "set_next":
                state["next_action"] = e["value"]
            state["seq"] = e["seq"]
            applied.append(e["seq"])
        print(f"applied events {applied}, skipped already-included events {skipped}, ignored torn trailing records {torn}")
        print("recovered state:", state)
        print("replaying only events newer than the snapshot rebuilt the state and the half-written last record was ignored; deciding whether a torn record means a lost operation still needs a policy, and the event order and replay rules here are our own")"}},{"type":"output","data":{"output":"

    new = copy.deepcopy(state)
    new["blockers"] = [{"description": b, "status": "open"} for b in new.get("blockers", [])]
    new["schema_version"] = 2
    return new


def load_current(path):
    state = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    v = state.get("schema_version")
    if v == 2:
        return state, "already current"
    if v == 1:
        migrated = migrate_v1_to_v2(state)
        atomic_write(path, migrated)
        return migrated, "migrated 1 -> 2"
    raise ValueError(f"unsupported schema_version {v!r}: refusing to guess")"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"rm_3.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() migrates and reloads, refuses three unsupported versions, migrates a malformed input, runs two real writer threads with and without a revision check and replays an event log over a snapshot.","descKn":"main() migrate ಮಾಡಿ ಮರುಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ಮೂರು ಬೆಂಬಲವಿಲ್ಲದ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಿ, ತಪ್ಪಾದ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ migrate ಮಾಡಿ, revision ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಜೊತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಎರಡು ನಿಜ writer threads ಓಡಿಸಿ snapshot ಮೇಲೆ ಈವೆಂಟ್ ಲಾಗ್ ಮರುಪ್ರಸಾರ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def section(t):
    print(f"\n--- {t} ---")


def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        root = Path(d)
        p = root / "agent_state.json"

        section("1. Genuinely running: a v1 file is migrated once and the migration is repeatable")
        v1 = {"schema_version": 1, "active_task_id": "T-014", "blockers": ["fixture format unclear"], "next_action": "inspect the fixture"}
        atomic_write(p, v1)
        backup = root / "agent_state.v1.bak"
        backup.write_text(p.read_text(), encoding="utf-8")
        s, how = load_current(p)
        print(how, "->", s["schema_version"], s["blockers"])
        s2, how2 = load_current(p)
        print("second load:", how2, "| identical to the first result:", s2 == s)
        print("original preserved as a backup with version", json.loads(backup.read_text())["schema_version"], "and blockers", json.loads(backup.read_text())["blockers"])
        print("a version-aware loader runs only the migration the file needs; repeating the rename blindly would have corrupted an already-migrated file")

        section("2. Genuinely checking: an unsupported version is refused")
        for v in (3, "1", None):
            atomic_write(p, {"schema_version": v, "active_task_id": "T-014"})
            try:
                load_current(p)
            except ValueError as e:
                print(f"version {v!r:5} -> {e}")
        print("a program that guessed at a newer or malformed version could misread fields silently; refusing stops it and points at the missing migration")

        section("3. Genuinely checking: a migration that does not validate its input or its output")
        atomic_write(p, {"schema_version": 1, "active_task_id": "T-014", "blockers": "not a list"})
        before = p.read_text()
        try:
            s3, how3 = load_current(p)
            print("no exception:", how3, "-> blockers now has", len(s3["blockers"]), "entries, first three:", s3["blockers"][:3])
        except Exception as e:
            print("migration failed with", type(e).__name__)
        print("file on disk changed by the migration:", p.read_text() != before)
        print("the input was a string where a list belongs, iterating it produced one 'blocker' per character, and the garbage was written over the original; a migration must validate the old document before transforming it and the new document before writing it, and keep the backup taken in section 1 until the result is verified")

        section("4. Genuinely measuring: two writers update the same file, with and without a revision check (real threads)")
        def run(guarded):
            path = root / ("g.json" if guarded else "u.json")
            atomic_write(path, {"revision": 1, "blockers": [], "next_action": "start"})
            lock, barrier, out = threading.Lock(), threading.Barrier(2), {}

            def writer(name, field, value):
                state = json.loads(path.read_text())  # both read revision 1
                barrier.wait()
                with lock:
                    cur = json.loads(path.read_text())
                    if guarded and cur["revision"] != state["revision"]:
                        out[name] = "rejected (stale)"
                        return
                    state[field] = value
                    state["revision"] = cur["revision"] + 1
                    atomic_write(path, state)
                    out[name] = "saved"
            a = threading.Thread(target=writer, args=("A", "blockers", ["fixture unclear"]))
            b = threading.Thread(target=writer, args=("B", "next_action", "run the tests"))
            a.start(); b.start(); a.join(); b.join()
            return out, json.loads(path.read_text())
        for g in (False, True):
            out, final = run(g)
            print(f"revision check={g!s:5} outcomes {dict(sorted(out.items()))} final file: blockers={final['blockers']} next_action={final['next_action']!r}")
        print("without the check both writers reported success but one of the two changes is missing from the final file (whichever wrote first was overwritten from a stale copy); with the check the later writer was told to reload, and which writer loses depends on timing")

        section("5. Genuinely checking: snapshot plus event log recovery")
        snap, log = root / "snapshot.json", root / "events.jsonl"
        atomic_write(snap, {"seq": 2, "blockers": [], "next_action": "start"})
        events = [{"seq": 3, "op": "set_blocker", "value": "fixture unclear"}, {"seq": 4, "op": "set_next", "value": "inspect fixture"}, {"seq": 2, "op": "set_next", "value": "stale event"}]
        log.write_text("\n".join(json.dumps(e) for e in events) + '\n{"seq": 5, "op": "set_nex', encoding="utf-8")  # the last line is cut off by a crash
        state = json.loads(snap.read_text())
        applied, skipped, torn = [], [], 0
        for line in log.read_text().splitlines():
            try:
                e = json.loads(line)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                torn += 1
                continue
            if e["seq"] <= state["seq"]:
                skipped.append(e["seq"])
                continue
            if e["op"] == "set_blocker":
                state["blockers"].append(e["value"])
            elif e["op"] == "set_next":
                state["next_action"] = e["value"]
            state["seq"] = e["seq"]
            applied.append(e["seq"])
        print(f"applied events {applied}, skipped already-included events {skipped}, ignored torn trailing records {torn}")
        print("recovered state:", state)
        print("replaying only events newer than the snapshot rebuilt the state and the half-written last record was ignored; deciding whether a torn record means a lost operation still needs a policy, and the event order and replay rules here are our own")"}},{"type":"output","data":{"output":"

Section 5: replaying a log over a snapshot at seq 2 applied events 3 and 4, skipped the already-included event 2 and ignored 1 torn trailing record, giving blockers ["fixture unclear"] and next_action "inspect fixture" at seq 4.","bodyKn":"ವಿಭಾಗ 4 (ಎರಡು ನಿಜ threads, ಎರಡೂ revision 1 ಓದಿದವು): ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಎರಡೂ "saved" ವರದಿ ಮಾಡಿದವು ಮತ್ತು ಅಂತಿಮ ಫೈಲ್ ಎರಡು ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಉಳಿಸಿತು (blockers ಹೊಂದಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು, next_action ಇನ್ನೂ "start"); revision ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಉಳಿಸಿತು ಮತ್ತು ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಹಳೆಯದು ಎಂದು ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿತು. ಯಾವ writer ಸೋಲುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದು ಸಮಯವನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ವಿಭಾಗ 5: seq 2 ರ snapshot ಮೇಲೆ ಲಾಗ್ ಮರುಪ್ರಸಾರ ಈವೆಂಟ್‌ಗಳು 3 ಮತ್ತು 4 ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಿ, ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಒಳಗೊಂಡ ಈವೆಂಟ್ 2 ಬಿಟ್ಟು, 1 ಹರಿದ ಕೊನೆಯ ದಾಖಲೆ ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷಿಸಿ, seq 4 ರಲ್ಲಿ blockers ["fixture unclear"] ಮತ್ತು next_action "inspect fixture" ನೀಡಿತು."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Why AI Uses This","headingKn":"AI ಇದನ್ನು ಏಕೆ ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ","bodyEn":"State that outlives sessions will be migrated, written concurrently and cut off by crashes, so each of those needs a deliberate mechanism and a test, including the failure path of the mechanism itself.","bodyKn":"ಸೆಷನ್‌ಗಳಿಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕಾಲ ಬದುಕುವ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ migrate ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಏಕಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆಯಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ರ್ಯಾಶ್‌ಗಳಿಂದ ಕತ್ತರಿಸಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದಕ್ಕೂ ಉದ್ದೇಶಪೂರ್ವಕ ಕಾರ್ಯವಿಧಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಬೇಕು, ಕಾರ್ಯವಿಧಾನದ ವೈಫಲ್ಯ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಸೇರಿ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Common Misconception","headingKn":"ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ತಪ್ಪು ಕಲ್ಪನೆ","bodyEn":"Misconception: "a migration that did not raise an error worked." ಭವಿಷ್ಯದ ಸಮಯಮುದ್ರೆ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def result(name, status, detail):
    return {"name": name, "status": status, "detail": detail}


def probe_python(required=(3, 10)):
    actual = sys.version_info[:2]
    ok = actual >= required
    return result("python_version", "pass" if ok else "fail", f"Python {actual[0]}.{actual[1]}" + ("" if ok else f" < required {required[0]}.{required[1]}"))


def probe_dependencies(packages):
    missing = []
    for p in packages:
        try:
            spec = importlib.util.find_spec(p)
        except (ImportError, ValueError):
            spec = None
        if spec is None:
            missing.append(p)
    return result("dependencies", "fail" if missing else "pass", ("Missing: " + ", ".join(missing)) if missing else "all discoverable")


def probe_test_command(cmd):
    path = shutil.which(cmd)
    return result("test_command", "pass" if path else "fail", f"resolved {path}" if path else f"not found on PATH: {cmd}")


def probe_env(names):
    missing = [n for n in names if not os.environ.get(n)]
    return result("environment", "fail" if missing else "pass", ("Missing: " + ", ".join(missing)) if missing else "required variables present")


def probe_state(path, max_hours=24):
    path = Path(path)
    if not path.is_file():
        return result("state_freshness", "fail", f"state file not found: {path.name}")
    age = (time.time() - path.stat().st_mtime) / 3600
    if age < 0:
        return result("state_freshness", "fail", "modification time is in the future")
    if age > max_hours:
        return result("state_freshness", "fail", f"{age:.1f} h old, limit {max_hours}")
    return result("state_freshness", "pass", f"{age:.2f} h old")


def report(probes):
    fails = [p for p in probes if p["status"] == "fail"]
    return {"healthy": not fails, "failure_count": len(fails), "probes": probes}"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"in_1.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() runs the probes with satisfiable requirements, then with impossible ones, passes the report to a real subprocess that exits 0 or 1, sets file modification times with os.utime to test freshness and runs the probes twice to compare reports.","descKn":"main() ತೃಪ್ತಿಪಡಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಂತರ ಅಸಾಧ್ಯವಾದವುಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ probes ಓಡಿಸಿ, ವರದಿಯನ್ನು 0 ಅಥವಾ 1 ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ನಿರ್ಗಮಿಸುವ ನಿಜ subprocess ಗೆ ನೀಡಿ, ತಾಜಾತನ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು os.utime ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಫೈಲ್ ಮಾರ್ಪಾಡು ಸಮಯ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ವರದಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಲು probes ಎರಡು ಬಾರಿ ಓಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def section(t):

def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        state = Path(d) / "agent_state.json"
        state.write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
        os.environ["LAB_API_KEY"] = "dummy-value-not-a-secret"

        section("1. Genuinely running: all five probes on this machine with satisfiable requirements")
        probes = [probe_python((3, 8)), probe_dependencies(["json", "pathlib"]), probe_test_command("python"), probe_env(["LAB_API_KEY"]), probe_state(state)]
        for p in probes:
            print(f"{p['status'].upper():5} {p['name']:16} {p['detail'][:70]}")
        rep = report(probes)
        print("healthy:", rep["healthy"], "| failures:", rep["failure_count"])
        print("the details name what was found and never print the value of the environment variable; a pass here says the check ran against this machine today and nothing about the application")

        section("2. Genuinely running: the same probes with requirements this machine cannot meet")
        probes = [probe_python((9, 0)), probe_dependencies(["json", "no_such_package_xyz"]), probe_test_command("no-such-test-runner"), probe_env(["LAB_MISSING_VARIABLE"]), probe_state(Path(d) / "gone.json")]
        for p in probes:
            print(f"{p['status'].upper():5} {p['name']:16} {p['detail'][:70]}")
        rep = report(probes)
        print("healthy:", rep["healthy"], "| failures:", rep["failure_count"])
        print("all five failed independently and the report collected every failure instead of stopping at the first, so one run lists all five things to fix")

        section("3. Genuinely checking: the report and the exit code through a real subprocess")
        code = ("import json,sys;r=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);print('RESULT:', 'HEALTHY' if r['healthy'] else 'BLOCKED');sys.exit(0 if r['healthy'] else 1)")
        for label, r in (("healthy report", report([probe_python((3, 8))])), ("blocked report", rep)):
            p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code, json.dumps(r)], capture_output=True, text=True)
            print(f"{label:15} printed {p.stdout.strip():16} exit code {p.returncode}")
        print("a printed BLOCKED with exit code 0 would let the agent launch anyway; the launcher acts on the exit code, so the code has to be non-zero when a blocking probe fails")

        section("4. Genuinely checking: state freshness at the edges (modification times set with os.utime)")
        for label, offset_h in (("fresh (1 h old)", 1), ("old (30 h old)", 30), ("future (+2 h)", -2)):
            t = time.time() - offset_h * 3600
            os.utime(state, (t, t))
            print(f"{label:16} {probe_state(state)}")
        os.utime(state, None)
        state.write_text("{not json", encoding="utf-8")
        print("fresh file with broken content:", probe_state(state))
        print("freshness only reads the modification time, so a file that was just written but is corrupt still passes; a content check is a separate probe")

        section("5. Genuinely measuring: idempotency, the report differs only in volatile fields")
        def run_once():
            ps = [probe_python((3, 8)), probe_dependencies(["json"]), probe_test_command("python"), probe_env(["LAB_API_KEY"]), probe_state(state)]
            r = report(ps)
            r["generated_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
            return r
        a, b = run_once(), run_once()
        same = {k: a[k] == b[k] for k in a}
        print(same)

ಭವಿಷ್ಯದ ಸಮಯಮುದ್ರೆ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def result(name, status, detail):
    return {"name": name, "status": status, "detail": detail}


def probe_python(required=(3, 10)):
    actual = sys.version_info[:2]
    ok = actual >= required
    return result("python_version", "pass" if ok else "fail", f"Python {actual[0]}.{actual[1]}" + ("" if ok else f" < required {required[0]}.{required[1]}"))


def probe_dependencies(packages):
    missing = []
    for p in packages:
        try:
            spec = importlib.util.find_spec(p)
        except (ImportError, ValueError):
            spec = None
        if spec is None:
            missing.append(p)
    return result("dependencies", "fail" if missing else "pass", ("Missing: " + ", ".join(missing)) if missing else "all discoverable")


def probe_test_command(cmd):
    path = shutil.which(cmd)
    return result("test_command", "pass" if path else "fail", f"resolved {path}" if path else f"not found on PATH: {cmd}")


def probe_env(names):
    missing = [n for n in names if not os.environ.get(n)]
    return result("environment", "fail" if missing else "pass", ("Missing: " + ", ".join(missing)) if missing else "required variables present")


def probe_state(path, max_hours=24):
    path = Path(path)
    if not path.is_file():
        return result("state_freshness", "fail", f"state file not found: {path.name}")
    age = (time.time() - path.stat().st_mtime) / 3600
    if age < 0:
        return result("state_freshness", "fail", "modification time is in the future")
    if age > max_hours:
        return result("state_freshness", "fail", f"{age:.1f} h old, limit {max_hours}")
    return result("state_freshness", "pass", f"{age:.2f} h old")


def report(probes):
    fails = [p for p in probes if p["status"] == "fail"]
    return {"healthy": not fails, "failure_count": len(fails), "probes": probes}"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"in_1.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() runs the probes with satisfiable requirements, then with impossible ones, passes the report to a real subprocess that exits 0 or 1, sets file modification times with os.utime to test freshness and runs the probes twice to compare reports.","descKn":"main() ತೃಪ್ತಿಪಡಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಂತರ ಅಸಾಧ್ಯವಾದವುಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ probes ಓಡಿಸಿ, ವರದಿಯನ್ನು 0 ಅಥವಾ 1 ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ನಿರ್ಗಮಿಸುವ ನಿಜ subprocess ಗೆ ನೀಡಿ, ತಾಜಾತನ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು os.utime ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಫೈಲ್ ಮಾರ್ಪಾಡು ಸಮಯ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ವರದಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಲು probes ಎರಡು ಬಾರಿ ಓಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def section(t):
    print(f"\n--- {t} ---")


def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        state = Path(d) / "agent_state.json"
        state.write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
        os.environ["LAB_API_KEY"] = "dummy-value-not-a-secret"

        section("1. Genuinely running: all five probes on this machine with satisfiable requirements")
        probes = [probe_python((3, 8)), probe_dependencies(["json", "pathlib"]), probe_test_command("python"), probe_env(["LAB_API_KEY"]), probe_state(state)]
        for p in probes:
            print(f"{p['status'].upper():5} {p['name']:16} {p['detail'][:70]}")
        rep = report(probes)
        print("healthy:", rep["healthy"], "| failures:", rep["failure_count"])
        print("the details name what was found and never print the value of the environment variable; a pass here says the check ran against this machine today and nothing about the application")

        section("2. Genuinely running: the same probes with requirements this machine cannot meet")
        probes = [probe_python((9, 0)), probe_dependencies(["json", "no_such_package_xyz"]), probe_test_command("no-such-test-runner"), probe_env(["LAB_MISSING_VARIABLE"]), probe_state(Path(d) / "gone.json")]
        for p in probes:
            print(f"{p['status'].upper():5} {p['name']:16} {p['detail'][:70]}")
        rep = report(probes)
        print("healthy:", rep["healthy"], "| failures:", rep["failure_count"])
        print("all five failed independently and the report collected every failure instead of stopping at the first, so one run lists all five things to fix")

        section("3. Genuinely checking: the report and the exit code through a real subprocess")
        code = ("import json,sys;r=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);print('RESULT:', 'HEALTHY' if r['healthy'] else 'BLOCKED');sys.exit(0 if r['healthy'] else 1)")
        for label, r in (("healthy report", report([probe_python((3, 8))])), ("blocked report", rep)):
            p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code, json.dumps(r)], capture_output=True, text=True)
            print(f"{label:15} printed {p.stdout.strip():16} exit code {p.returncode}")
        print("a printed BLOCKED with exit code 0 would let the agent launch anyway; the launcher acts on the exit code, so the code has to be non-zero when a blocking probe fails")

        section("4. Genuinely checking: state freshness at the edges (modification times set with os.utime)")
        for label, offset_h in (("fresh (1 h old)", 1), ("old (30 h old)", 30), ("future (+2 h)", -2)):

probe_dependencies(packages):
    missing = []
    for p in packages:
        try:
            spec = importlib.util.find_spec(p)
        except (ImportError, ValueError, AttributeError):
            spec = None
        if spec is None:
            missing.append(p)
    return missing


def import_smoke(name):
    try:
        importlib.import_module(name)
        return "imports"
    except Exception as e:
        return f"import failed: {type(e).__name__}"


def run_probe_safely(name, fn):
    try:
        r = fn()
        if not isinstance(r, dict) or {"name", "status", "detail"} - r.keys() or r["status"] not in ("pass", "fail"):
            raise ValueError("bad probe result")
        return r
    except Exception as e:
        return {"name": name, "status": "fail", "detail": f"probe error: {type(e).__name__}"}


def probe_env(names):
    return [n for n in names if not os.environ.get(n)]"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"in_2.py","headingEn":"main(): six experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಆರು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() queries find_spec with seven names, creates a broken and a working module in a temporary directory, builds a fake command that exits 3, tries four environment variable values, runs a crashing and a malformed probe and changes the working directory.","descKn":"main() ಏಳು ಹೆಸರುಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ find_spec ಕೇಳಿ, ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮುರಿದ ಮತ್ತು ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುವ ಮಾಡ್ಯೂಲ್ ರಚಿಸಿ, 3 ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ನಿರ್ಗಮಿಸುವ ನಕಲಿ ಆದೇಶ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ, ನಾಲ್ಕು ಪರಿಸರ ವೇರಿಯಬಲ್ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ, ಕ್ರ್ಯಾಶ್ ಮತ್ತು ತಪ್ಪಾದ probe ಓಡಿಸಿ ಕೆಲಸದ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def section(t):
    print(f"\n--- {t} ---")


def main():
    section("1. Genuinely checking: import names versus installer package names")
    for name in ("json", "yaml", "PyYAML", "os.path", "no_pkg.sub", "email.mime.text", ""):
        try:
            found = importlib.util.find_spec(name) is not None
            print(f"find_spec({name!r:18}) discoverable={found}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"find_spec({name!r:18}) raised {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
    print("a dependency list written with installer names (PyYAML) fails a probe that expects import names (yaml); a dotted name whose parent is missing raises ModuleNotFoundError instead of returning None, while an empty name simply came back as not discoverable on this Python (other versions may raise ValueError), so the probe has to catch the exceptions as well as the None")
    print("whether yaml is installed depends on this machine and is not a property of the lesson")

    section("2. Genuinely checking: discoverable is not importable")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        (Path(d) / "broken_dep.py").write_text("import module_that_does_not_exist\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (Path(d) / "fine_dep.py").write_text("VALUE = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
        sys.path.insert(0, d)
        try:
            for n in ("fine_dep", "broken_dep"):
                print(f"{n:12} find_spec found it: {importlib.util.find_spec(n) is not None} | import: {import_smoke(n)}")
        finally:
            sys.path.remove(d)
    print("find_spec located the broken module because it only looks for the file; the import smoke test caught the failure, at the price of running that module's top-level code during startup, so it should be limited to trusted dependencies")

    section("3. Genuinely checking: a command that resolves but does not launch")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        script = Path(d) / ("fake_runner.bat" if os.name == "nt" else "fake_runner")
        script.write_text("@echo off\r\nexit /b 3\r\n" if os.name == "nt" else "#!/bin/sh\nexit 3\n", encoding="utf-8")
        if os.name != "nt":
            script.chmod(0o755)
        old = os.environ["PATH"]
        os.environ["PATH"] = d + os.pathsep + old
        try:
            path = shutil.which("fake_runner")
            print("which found it:", path is not None)
            p = subprocess.run([path, "--version"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
            print("launching it with --version exited with", p.returncode)
        finally:
            os.environ["PATH"] = old
    print("resolving a command only proves a file with that name is on PATH; running --version is a second, stronger level, and running the real tests is a third, which belongs to verification and not to startup")

    section("4. Genuinely checking: environment variables that are set but useless")
    for label, value in (("unset", None), ("empty string", ""), ("whitespace only", "   "), ("a real-looking value", "abc123")):
        if value is None:
            os.environ.pop("LAB_VAR", None)
        else:
            os.environ["LAB_VAR"] = value
        print(f"{label:22} flagged as missing by a truthiness check: {bool(probe_env(['LAB_VAR']))}")
    os.environ.pop("LAB_VAR", None)
    print("a whitespace-only value passed the truthiness check although it is useless; presence is not validity, and a format or live check would be a separate, bounded probe that must not print the value")

    section("5. Genuinely checking: a probe that crashes")
    def good():
        return {"name": "ok", "status": "pass", "detail": "fine"}
    def crashes():
        return 1 / 0
    def malformed():
        return {"name": "bad", "status": "maybe"}
    def unsafe_orchestrator(fns):
        return [f() for f in fns]
    try:
        unsafe_orchestrator([good, crashes, good])
    except ZeroDivisionError:
        print("unsafe orchestrator: ZeroDivisionError aborted the whole run, no report was produced")
    for fn in (good, crashes, malformed):
        print(" ", run_probe_safely(fn.__name__, fn))
    print("the wrapper turns a crash and a malformed result into a failing record and keeps going, so the report is still written; it records only the exception type, not its message, which could contain paths or secrets")

    section("6. Genuinely checking: the working-directory trap")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        here = Path.cwd()
        try:
            os.chdir(d)
            print("cwd inside the temp directory contains README.md:", (Path.cwd() / "README.md").exists())
            (Path(d) / "README.md").write_text("x", encoding="utf-8")
            print("after creating one, the same check says:", (Path.cwd() / "README.md").exists())
        finally:
            os.chdir(here)
    print("a script that builds paths from the current directory trusts wherever it was launched from; checking a repository marker such as README.md (or locating the root from the script's own path) turns a wrong-directory mistake into a clear failure")"}},{"type":"output","data":{"output":"

probe_dependencies(packages):
    missing = []
    for p in packages:
        try:
            spec = importlib.util.find_spec(p)
        except (ImportError, ValueError, AttributeError):
            spec = None
        if spec is None:
            missing.append(p)
    return missing


def import_smoke(name):
    try:
        importlib.import_module(name)
        return "imports"
    except Exception as e:
        return f"import failed: {type(e).__name__}"


def run_probe_safely(name, fn):
    try:
        r = fn()
        if not isinstance(r, dict) or {"name", "status", "detail"} - r.keys() or r["status"] not in ("pass", "fail"):
            raise ValueError("bad probe result")
        return r
    except Exception as e:
        return {"name": name, "status": "fail", "detail": f"probe error: {type(e).__name__}"}


def probe_env(names):
    return [n for n in names if not os.environ.get(n)]"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"in_2.py","headingEn":"main(): six experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಆರು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() queries find_spec with seven names, creates a broken and a working module in a temporary directory, builds a fake command that exits 3, tries four environment variable values, runs a crashing and a malformed probe and changes the working directory.","descKn":"main() ಏಳು ಹೆಸರುಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ find_spec ಕೇಳಿ, ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮುರಿದ ಮತ್ತು ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುವ ಮಾಡ್ಯೂಲ್ ರಚಿಸಿ, 3 ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ನಿರ್ಗಮಿಸುವ ನಕಲಿ ಆದೇಶ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ, ನಾಲ್ಕು ಪರಿಸರ ವೇರಿಯಬಲ್ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ, ಕ್ರ್ಯಾಶ್ ಮತ್ತು ತಪ್ಪಾದ probe ಓಡಿಸಿ ಕೆಲಸದ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def section(t):
    print(f"\n--- {t} ---")


def main():
    section("1. Genuinely checking: import names versus installer package names")
    for name in ("json", "yaml", "PyYAML", "os.path", "no_pkg.sub", "email.mime.text", ""):
        try:
            found = importlib.util.find_spec(name) is not None
            print(f"find_spec({name!r:18}) discoverable={found}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"find_spec({name!r:18}) raised {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
    print("a dependency list written with installer names (PyYAML) fails a probe that expects import names (yaml); a dotted name whose parent is missing raises ModuleNotFoundError instead of returning None, while an empty name simply came back as not discoverable on this Python (other versions may raise ValueError), so the probe has to catch the exceptions as well as the None")
    print("whether yaml is installed depends on this machine and is not a property of the lesson")

    section("2. Genuinely checking: discoverable is not importable")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        (Path(d) / "broken_dep.py").write_text("import module_that_does_not_exist\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (Path(d) / "fine_dep.py").write_text("VALUE = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
        sys.path.insert(0, d)
        try:
            for n in ("fine_dep", "broken_dep"):
                print(f"{n:12} find_spec found it: {importlib.util.find_spec(n) is not None} | import: {import_smoke(n)}")
        finally:
            sys.path.remove(d)
    print("find_spec located the broken module because it only looks for the file; the import smoke test caught the failure, at the price of running that module's top-level code during startup, so it should be limited to trusted dependencies")

    section("3. Genuinely checking: a command that resolves but does not launch")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        script = Path(d) / ("fake_runner.bat" if os.name == "nt" else "fake_runner")
        script.write_text("@echo off\r\nexit /b 3\r\n" if os.name == "nt" else "#!/bin/sh\nexit 3\n", encoding="utf-8")
        if os.name != "nt":
            script.chmod(0o755)
        old = os.environ["PATH"]
        os.environ["PATH"] = d + os.pathsep + old
        try:
            path = shutil.which("fake_runner")
            print("which found it:", path is not None)
            p = subprocess.run([path, "--version"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
            print("launching it with --version exited with", p.returncode)
        finally:
            os.environ["PATH"] = old
    print("resolving a command only proves a file with that name is on PATH; running --version is a second, stronger level, and running the real tests is a third, which belongs to verification and not to startup")

    section("4. Genuinely checking: environment variables that are set but useless")
    for label, value in (("unset", None), ("empty string", ""), ("whitespace only", "   "), ("a real-looking value", "abc123")):
        if value is None:
            os.environ.pop("LAB_VAR", None)
        else:
            os.environ["LAB_VAR"] = value
        print(f"{label:22} flagged as missing by a truthiness check: {bool(probe_env(['LAB_VAR']))}")
    os.environ.pop("LAB_VAR", None)
    print("a whitespace-only value passed the truthiness check although it is useless; presence is not validity, and a format or live check would be a separate, bounded probe that must not print the value")

    section("5. Genuinely checking: a probe that crashes")
    def good():
        return {"name": "ok", "status": "pass", "detail": "fine"}
    def crashes():
        return 1 / 0
    def malformed():
        return {"name": "bad", "status": "maybe"}
    def unsafe_orchestrator(fns):
        return [f() for f in fns]
    try:
        unsafe_orchestrator([good, crashes, good])
    except ZeroDivisionError:
        print("unsafe orchestrator: ZeroDivisionError aborted the whole run, no report was produced")
    for fn in (good, crashes, malformed):
        print(" ", run_probe_safely(fn.__name__, fn))
    print("the wrapper turns a crash and a malformed result into a failing record and keeps going, so the report is still written; it records only the exception type, not its message, which could contain paths or secrets")

    section("6. Genuinely checking: the working-directory trap")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        here = Path.cwd()
        try:
            os.chdir(d)
            print("cwd inside the temp directory contains README.md:", (Path.cwd() / "README.md").exists())
            (Path(d) / "README.md").write_text("x", encoding="utf-8")
            print("after creating one, the same check says:", (Path.cwd() / "README.md").exists())
        finally:
            os.chdir(here)
    print("a script that builds paths from the current directory trusts wherever it was launched from; checking a repository marker such as README.md (or locating the root from the script's own path) turns a wrong-directory mistake into a clear failure")"}},{"type":"output","data":{"output":"

def git(repo, *args, strip=True):
    out = subprocess.run(GIT + list(args), cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
    return out.strip() if strip else out.rstrip(chr(10))


def changed_since(repo, base):
    committed = set(git(repo, "diff", "--name-only", f"{base}..HEAD").splitlines())
    working = set(git(repo, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all", strip=False).splitlines())
    working = {line[3:] for line in working}
    return committed | working


def scope_check(repo, base, budget):
    files = sorted(changed_since(repo, base))
    return ("fail" if len(files) > budget else "pass"), len(files)


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def cache_valid(cache, manifest, now, ttl, runtime):
    if not cache:
        return False, "no cache"
    if now - cache["checked_at"] > ttl:
        return False, "expired"
    if cache["manifest_sha"] != sha(manifest):
        return False, "manifest changed"
    if cache["runtime"] != runtime:
        return False, "runtime changed"
    return True, "fresh and inputs unchanged""}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"in_3.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() builds a temporary git repository and measures the change budget before and after committing, tests the cache against age, manifest and runtime changes, runs a launcher through two initializers and compares repository hashes around two read-only runs.","descKn":"main() ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ git repository ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ commit ಮಾಡುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಮತ್ತು ನಂತರ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಬಜೆಟ್ ಅಳೆದು, ಕ್ಯಾಶ್ ಅನ್ನು ವಯಸ್ಸು, manifest ಮತ್ತು runtime ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ, ಎರಡು initializers ಮೂಲಕ ಲಾಂಚರ್ ಓಡಿಸಿ ಎರಡು ಓದಲು-ಮಾತ್ರ ಓಟಗಳ ಸುತ್ತ repository hash ಹೋಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def section(t):

def git(repo, *args, strip=True):
    out = subprocess.run(GIT + list(args), cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
    return out.strip() if strip else out.rstrip(chr(10))


def changed_since(repo, base):
    committed = set(git(repo, "diff", "--name-only", f"{base}..HEAD").splitlines())
    working = set(git(repo, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all", strip=False).splitlines())
    working = {line[3:] for line in working}
    return committed | working


def scope_check(repo, base, budget):
    files = sorted(changed_since(repo, base))
    return ("fail" if len(files) > budget else "pass"), len(files)


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def cache_valid(cache, manifest, now, ttl, runtime):
    if not cache:
        return False, "no cache"
    if now - cache["checked_at"] > ttl:
        return False, "expired"
    if cache["manifest_sha"] != sha(manifest):
        return False, "manifest changed"
    if cache["runtime"] != runtime:
        return False, "runtime changed"
    return True, "fresh and inputs unchanged""}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"in_3.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() builds a temporary git repository and measures the change budget before and after committing, tests the cache against age, manifest and runtime changes, runs a launcher through two initializers and compares repository hashes around two read-only runs.","descKn":"main() ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ git repository ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ commit ಮಾಡುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಮತ್ತು ನಂತರ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಬಜೆಟ್ ಅಳೆದು, ಕ್ಯಾಶ್ ಅನ್ನು ವಯಸ್ಸು, manifest ಮತ್ತು runtime ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ, ಎರಡು initializers ಮೂಲಕ ಲಾಂಚರ್ ಓಡಿಸಿ ಎರಡು ಓದಲು-ಮಾತ್ರ ಓಟಗಳ ಸುತ್ತ repository hash ಹೋಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def section(t):

off_scope.","code":"def load_contract(path):
    try:
        c = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as e:
        raise ValueError(f"cannot read contract: {type(e).__name__}")
    if not isinstance(c, dict):
        raise ValueError("contract must be an object")
    missing = [k for k in REQUIRED if k not in c]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError("missing fields: " + ", ".join(missing))
    for k in ("task_id", "goal", "rollback_plan"):
        if not isinstance(c[k], str) or not c[k].strip():
            raise ValueError(f"{k} must be a non-empty string")
    for k in LISTS:
        if not isinstance(c[k], list) or not all(isinstance(x, str) for x in c[k]):
            raise ValueError(f"{k} must be a list of strings")
    if not c["allowed_files"]:
        raise ValueError("allowed_files is empty: nothing could ever be in scope")
    return c


def norm(p):
    return p.replace("\\", "/")


def matches(path, pattern):
    path, pattern = norm(path), norm(pattern)
    if pattern.endswith("/**"):
        return path.startswith(pattern[:-3] + "/")
    return fnmatchcase(path, pattern)


def safe_path(p):
    parts = [x for x in norm(p).split("/") if x not in ("", ".")]
    if ".." in parts:
        return None
    return "/".join(parts)


def classify(path, contract):
    if any(matches(path, p) for p in contract["forbidden_files"]):
        return "forbidden"
    if any(matches(path, p) for p in contract["allowed_files"]):
        return "allowed"
    return "off_scope""}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"sc_1.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() writes seven contracts to disk and loads each, classifies five paths against a contract whose allowlist overlaps its forbidden list, measures eight fnmatch cases, compares the recursive helper with plain fnmatch and sends four tricky paths through both the text match and safe_path.","descKn":"main() ಏಳು ಒಪ್ಪಂದಗಳನ್ನು ಡಿಸ್ಕ್‌ಗೆ ಬರೆದು ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದನ್ನು ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ಅನುಮತಿ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ನಿಷೇಧ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಅತಿಕ್ರಮಿಸುವ ಒಪ್ಪಂದದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಐದು paths ವರ್ಗೀಕರಿಸಿ, ಎಂಟು fnmatch ಪ್ರಕರಣ ಅಳೆದು, ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಕ helper ಅನ್ನು ಸಾದಾ fnmatch ಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ, ನಾಲ್ಕು ಕಷ್ಟದ paths ಅನ್ನು ಪಠ್ಯ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು safe_path ಎರಡರ ಮೂಲಕ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        section("1. Genuinely running: loading and validating contracts, including broken ones")
        cases = {"valid": GOOD}
        cases["missing rollback_plan"] = {k: v for k, v in GOOD.items() if k != "rollback_plan"}
        cases["allowed_files not a list"] = dict(GOOD, allowed_files="src/**")
        cases["empty allowed_files"] = dict(GOOD, allowed_files=[])
        cases["blank goal"] = dict(GOOD, goal="   ")
        cases["number inside a list"] = dict(GOOD, forbidden_files=["release/**", 7])
        for label, c in cases.items():
            f = Path(d) / "c.json"
            f.write_text(json.dumps(c), encoding="utf-8")

        section("2. Genuinely running: classifying paths, forbidden wins over allowed")

            print(f"{p:26} -> {classify(p, broad)}")
        print("src/database/driver.py matches both the allowed src/** and the forbidden src/database/**, and was classified forbidden because forbidden patterns are checked first; the opposite order would have let the broad allowance override the prohibition")

        section("3. Genuinely measuring: what fnmatch globs actually match on this Python")
        tests = [("src/auth/login.py", "src/*.py"), ("src/auth/login.py", "src/auth/*.py"), ("src/auth/deep/x.py", "src/auth/*.py"), ("tests/test_login.py", "tests/test_login*.py"),

        section("4. Genuinely running: the recursive-pattern helper versus plain fnmatch")
        for path, pat in (("src/auth/login.py", "src/auth/**"), ("src/auth/deep/x.py", "src/auth/**"), ("src/author.py", "src/auth/**"), ("src/auth", "src/auth/**"), ("src/auth/login.py", "src/**/login.py")):

off_scope.","code":"def load_contract(path):
    try:
        c = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as e:
        raise ValueError(f"cannot read contract: {type(e).__name__}")
    if not isinstance(c, dict):
        raise ValueError("contract must be an object")
    missing = [k for k in REQUIRED if k not in c]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError("missing fields: " + ", ".join(missing))
    for k in ("task_id", "goal", "rollback_plan"):
        if not isinstance(c[k], str) or not c[k].strip():
            raise ValueError(f"{k} must be a non-empty string")
    for k in LISTS:
        if not isinstance(c[k], list) or not all(isinstance(x, str) for x in c[k]):
            raise ValueError(f"{k} must be a list of strings")
    if not c["allowed_files"]:
        raise ValueError("allowed_files is empty: nothing could ever be in scope")
    return c


def norm(p):
    return p.replace("\\", "/")


def matches(path, pattern):
    path, pattern = norm(path), norm(pattern)
    if pattern.endswith("/**"):
        return path.startswith(pattern[:-3] + "/")
    return fnmatchcase(path, pattern)


def safe_path(p):
    parts = [x for x in norm(p).split("/") if x not in ("", ".")]
    if ".." in parts:
        return None
    return "/".join(parts)


def classify(path, contract):
    if any(matches(path, p) for p in contract["forbidden_files"]):
        return "forbidden"
    if any(matches(path, p) for p in contract["allowed_files"]):
        return "allowed"
    return "off_scope""}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"sc_1.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() writes seven contracts to disk and loads each, classifies five paths against a contract whose allowlist overlaps its forbidden list, measures eight fnmatch cases, compares the recursive helper with plain fnmatch and sends four tricky paths through both the text match and safe_path.","descKn":"main() ಏಳು ಒಪ್ಪಂದಗಳನ್ನು ಡಿಸ್ಕ್‌ಗೆ ಬರೆದು ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದನ್ನು ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ಅನುಮತಿ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ನಿಷೇಧ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಅತಿಕ್ರಮಿಸುವ ಒಪ್ಪಂದದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಐದು paths ವರ್ಗೀಕರಿಸಿ, ಎಂಟು fnmatch ಪ್ರಕರಣ ಅಳೆದು, ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಕ helper ಅನ್ನು ಸಾದಾ fnmatch ಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ, ನಾಲ್ಕು ಕಷ್ಟದ paths ಅನ್ನು ಪಠ್ಯ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು safe_path ಎರಡರ ಮೂಲಕ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():

        cases["blank goal"] = dict(GOOD, goal="   ")

    flag = [] if renames else ["--no-renames"]
    names = set(git(repo, "diff", "--name-only", *flag, base).splitlines())
    names |= set(git(repo, "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard").splitlines())
    return sorted(names)


def classify(path, c):
    if any(matches(path, p) for p in c["forbidden_files"]):
        return "forbidden"
    return "allowed" if any(matches(path, p) for p in c["allowed_files"]) else "off_scope"


def verdict(files, c):
    bad = [f for f in files if classify(f, c) != "allowed"]
    return ("BLOCK" if bad else "ALLOW"), bad


def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"sc_3.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() builds a repository with a baseline commit and a contract file, compares the agent list with git, moves a file out of an allowed directory, widens the contract from inside the task, rolls back selectively and with a hard reset, and writes the report.","descKn":"main() baseline commit ಮತ್ತು ಒಪ್ಪಂದ ಫೈಲ್ ಇರುವ repository ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ, agent ಪಟ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು git ಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ, ಅನುಮತಿಸಿದ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರಿಯಿಂದ ಫೈಲ್ ಸರಿಸಿ, ಕಾರ್ಯದೊಳಗಿಂದ ಒಪ್ಪಂದ ವಿಸ್ತರಿಸಿ, ಆಯ್ದ ಮತ್ತು hard reset ಮೂಲಕ rollback ಮಾಡಿ ವರದಿ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        repo = Path(d) / "repo"
        repo.mkdir()

        for rel, txt in (("src/auth/login.py", "v1\n"), ("release/deploy.sh", "echo deploy\n"), ("docs/guide.md", "guide\n"), ("src/auth/old.py", "legacy\n" * 5)):
            (repo / rel).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            (repo / rel).write_text(txt, encoding="utf-8")
        contract_path = repo / "scope_contract.json"
        contract = {"allowed_files": ["src/auth/**", "tests/test_login*.py"], "forbidden_files": ["release/**"]}
        contract_path.write_text(json.dumps(contract), encoding="utf-8")
        git(repo, "add", "-A")
        git(repo, "commit", "-q", "-m", "baseline")
        base = git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").strip()
        c0 = json.loads(contract_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        h0 = sha(contract_path)

        section("1. Genuinely running: touched files come from git, not from the agent's list")
        (repo / "src/auth/login.py").write_text("v2\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (repo / "tests").mkdir()
        (repo / "tests/test_login.py").write_text("t\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (repo / "release/deploy.sh").write_text("echo deploy --prod\n", encoding="utf-8")
        agent_list = ["src/auth/login.py", "tests/test_login.py"]
        real = touched(repo, base)
        print("agent said it touched:", agent_list)
        print("git says it touched  :", real)
        print("verdict from the agent list:", verdict(agent_list, c0)[0], "| verdict from git:", verdict(real, c0))
        print("the agent list omitted the deploy script it edited and git's diff did not; the new test file was found because the check also asks for files git does not track yet, which git diff alone would miss")

        section("2. Genuinely measuring: a rename out of an allowed directory")
        git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "--", "release/deploy.sh")
        git(repo, "mv", "src/auth/old.py", "release/old.py")
        print("with rename detection   :", touched(repo, base))
        print("without rename detection:", touched(repo, base, renames=False))
        print("with rename detection src/auth/old.py is missing from the list and only release/old.py appears; with --no-renames both ends of the move are listed, so the checker should use that form because the removal from the allowed directory is part of the change")
        git(repo, "reset", "-q", "--hard", base)

        section("3. Genuinely running: the agent edits the contract itself")
        (repo / "src/auth/login.py").write_text("v2\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (repo / "release/deploy.sh").write_text("echo deploy --prod\n", encoding="utf-8")
        widened = json.loads(contract_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        widened["allowed_files"] += ["release/**", "scope_contract.json"]
        widened["forbidden_files"] = []
        contract_path.write_text(json.dumps(widened), encoding="utf-8")
        files = touched(repo, base)
        print("changed files include the contract:", "scope_contract.json" in files)
        print("verdict against the widened contract on disk:", verdict(files, json.loads(contract_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))[0])
        print("verdict against the contract loaded at task start:", verdict(files, c0))
        print("contract hash still equals the start hash:", sha(contract_path) == h0)
        print("the widened contract that also allowed its own file gave ALLOW for a forbidden deploy-script edit, while the start contract blocked it and showed the contract edit as a violation; a contract read from the working tree lets the agent widen its own permissions; the contract has to be loaded from the baseline commit or from a location the agent cannot write, and a changed contract hash is itself a finding")
        git(repo, "reset", "-q", "--hard", base)
        git(repo, "clean", "-qfd")

        section("4. Genuinely running: rollback keeps the work that existed before the task")
        (repo / "docs/guide.md").write_text("human edit before the task\n", encoding="utf-8")
        before_task = sha(repo / "docs/guide.md")
        (repo / "src/auth/login.py").write_text("agent edit\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (repo / "release/deploy.sh").write_text("agent edit\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (repo / "scratch.txt").write_text("agent file\n", encoding="utf-8")
        tracked = git(repo, "ls-files").splitlines()
        for f in ("src/auth/login.py", "release/deploy.sh", "scratch.txt"):
            if f in tracked:
                git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "--", f)
            else:
                (repo / f).unlink()
        print("status after the targeted rollback:", git(repo, "status", "--porcelain").splitlines())
        print("human edit preserved:", sha(repo / "docs/guide.md") == before_task, "| login.py restored to:", (repo / "src/auth/login.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip())
        print("the targeted rollback restored only the files the task changed")

        print("after git reset --hard instead, docs/guide.md reads:", repr((repo / "docs/guide.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()), "| human edit preserved:", sha(repo / "docs/guide.md") == before_task)
        print("the hard reset destroyed the human's uncommitted edit, which is why rollback is scoped to the task's own files; the other hard resets in this lab are fine only because it owns the temporary repository")

        section("5. Genuinely running: the report is a file the next session can read")
        (repo / "release/deploy.sh").write_text("agent edit\n", encoding="utf-8")
        files = touched(repo, base)
        v, bad = verdict(files, c0)
        report = {"base_commit": base[:10], "contract_sha256": h0[:12], "files": files, "verdict": v, "violations": [{"file": f, "class": classify(f, c0)} for f in bad]}
        out = Path(d) / "scope_report.json"
        out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        back = json.loads(out.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        print(json.dumps(back, indent=2))
        print("the report names the baseline commit, the contract hash, every file and each violation with its class, so a later session or a reviewer can see why the task was blocked without rerunning anything; it does not undo the change, and the base commit and hash are shortened for display")"}},{"type":"output","data":{"output":"

    flag = [] if renames else ["--no-renames"]
    names = set(git(repo, "diff", "--name-only", *flag, base).splitlines())

def classify(path, c):

        return "forbidden"
    return "allowed" if any(matches(path, p) for p in c["allowed_files"]) else "off_scope"


def verdict(files, c):

    return ("BLOCK" if bad else "ALLOW"), bad

    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
